summary.name: MuseScore Studio
summary.one_liner: MuseScore Studio is free, open-source music notation software for creating, playing back and printing sheet music.
use_cases: writing sheet music for piano, guitar or orchestra
arranging music for choir or band
entering notes with a MIDI keyboard
exchanging scores with other notation programs via MusicXML
summary.what_it_does: MuseScore Studio lets users create, play back and print sheet music. It supports note input from a MIDI keyboard and can transfer scores to and from other programs using MusicXML and MIDI. The page lists use for piano, guitar, orchestra, jazz, choir, band and marching music. It is distributed for Windows, Mac and Linux, with the page showing the current version as 4.7.6 for macOS, and it is built by an open-source community.
notable: Open source, built by a community of contributors
MIDI keyboard input and MusicXML/MIDI file transfer
Official distributor MuseHub, or direct download without it
caveats: Page does not say whether MuseHub is required; a direct download without MuseHub is offered
